ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Neelkamal Tower Construction LLP, a promoter group entity of Advent Hotels International Limited, has announced the release of a pledge over 3,180,433 equity shares (5.90% of total share capital) in Advent Hotels International Limited. This positive development occurred due to the full repayment of an underlying loan facility by an associated entity, significantly reducing financial overhang and potential risks of forced selling from the promoter's holdings. While this is a positive move, approximately 1.85% of the company's total shares held by the promoter group remain encumbered, as per the disclosure.
